issue_context.body:

1. Issue may be deleted if it is not following the template
2. Only post one request per one feature request
3. Try not to make duplicates. Do a quick search before posting
4. Add a clarified title
-->

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
Not really a problem, but several apps (eg Journal, MS To-Do) have added ink gestures to manipulate items. I think this would be a cool thing to have in Files. 

**Describe the solution**
Add support for ink gestures for manipulating items in layout modes. Some gestures could be scribble to delete, circle to select multiple items, check to toggle selection.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Scope**
<!-- Please include a list of what the feature should and shouldn't do by filling in the table below.
'Must' implies that the feature should not ship without this capability.  
'Should' is something we should push hard for, but is not absolutely required to ship.
'Could' is a nice-to-have; a good stretch goal that isn't painful if we don't achieve it.
'Won't' is a clear statement that the proposal/feature will intentionally not have that capability.
This list will evolve and grow as the proposal becomes more refined over time.
A good rule of thumb is to start your proposal with no more than 7 high-level requirements.
-->
| Capability | Priority |
| :---------- | :------- |
| This proposal will allow users to manipulate elements with a pen | Must |

**Additional comment**
Example of how this could work:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/59544401/120905768-302a0e80-c609-11eb-82be-b462ba2a95d8.mp4
comments: This is a really cool idea, but I do hope that implementing it doesn't push v2.0 any further...

I think it's a great suggestion! I would also add a gesture to scribble or draw a line over the path to go up a folder, for example:
**Before:** C:\Users\filesuser\Desktop\folder\Pics
**Change:** C:\Users\filesuser\Desktop\ ***strikethrough*** folder\Pics ***end of strikethrough***
**After:** C:\Users\filesuser\Desktop\

> I think it's a great suggestion! I would also add a gesture to scribble or draw a line over the path to go up a folder, for example: **Before:** C:\Users\filesuser\Desktop\folder\Pics **Change:** C:\Users\filesuser\Desktop\ _**strikethrough**_ folder\Pics _**end of strikethrough**_ **After:** C:\Users\filesuser\Desktop\

I think that drawing on the address bar would register as a click and enter the edit mode. It's something to look into if we decide to move forward with this proposal.
It looks like WinAppSdk doesn't have support for InkCanvas yet.
Unless it gets pushed off, WinAppSdk is supposed to be getting InkCanvas in 1.7.
